candidates.source_name: CRPS — Centralni registar privrednih subjekata (public entity search)
candidates.why_relevant: Montenegro's statutory business register. Every change of an authorised representative (ovlašćeno lice / izvršni direktor) or board member of a bank, payment institution, e-money institution or fintech company is a legally mandated filing here, so it is both an authoritative leadership-change feed and the enumeration of all banking/payments legal entities to monitor.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic keyed lookup by registration number for a watchlist of banks/PSPs; diff the 'ovlašćena lica' / 'izvršni direktor' block between snapshots. Search endpoint appeared TLS-unfriendly to automated fetch in this run (SSL internal error over http->https upgrade) — treat as unverified, retry with a real browser UA/TLS stack.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language seed query + snowball from OpenCorporates register page
queries_used: CRPS Crna Gora Centralni registar privrednih subjekata pretraga
Montenegro business register company directors change search
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch returned SSL routines TLSV1_ALERT_INTERNAL_ERROR — hypothesis: site is live but rejects the fetcher's TLS handshake, not dead.

candidates.source_name: eFirma / CRPS portal (Uprava prihoda i carina) — registration and filing front end
candidates.why_relevant: The modern e-portal through which registrations and changes (including change of legal representative) are filed and published; the operational successor front end to the older crps.me pages, run by the Revenue and Customs Administration.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Map the portal's public search routes and any JSON endpoints behind the SPA; poll company records for a banking/payments watchlist.
queries_used: CRPS Crna Gora Centralni registar privrednih subjekata pretraga
registar stvarnih vlasnika Crna Gora CRPS

candidates.source_name: Registar stvarnih vlasnika (Beneficial Ownership Register), CRPS/eFirma
candidates.why_relevant: AML-mandated register of ultimate beneficial owners of Montenegrin entities, held inside the CRPS system since Aug 2021. Reveals control changes behind banks, payment institutions and fintech vehicles that a pure director listing misses.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query by entity for watchlist companies; snapshot-and-diff UBO records quarterly.
queries_used: registar stvarnih vlasnika Crna Gora CRPS beneficial ownership register

candidates.source_name: Službeni list Crne Gore (Official Gazette) — online document search
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes rješenja/odluke on appointments and dismissals (imenovanje, razrješenje) for state-linked financial bodies — Central Bank council members, state-owned/state-participated banks, regulators — plus the statutes and by-laws that reshape bank governance (e.g. the two-tier management/supervisory board regime).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll each new issue index; full-text keyword filter on 'imenovanje', 'razrješenje', 'banka', 'Centralna banka', 'platne usluge'. Document viewer uses GUID ids (pregled-dokumenta-2/?id={GUID}).
queries_used: Službeni list Crne Gore pretraga rješenje imenovanje banka

candidates.source_name: Katalog propisa (Montenegro consolidated legislation catalogue)
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial consolidation of Montenegrin legislation with an 'updated regulations' feed — a faster, better-indexed way to spot new banking/payments by-laws and governance rules than the raw gazette.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the public 'pregled ažuriranih propisa' listing for banking/payments entries; do not scrape paywalled full texts.
queries_used: Službeni list Crne Gore pretraga rješenje imenovanje banka

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Registar banaka (Register of Banks)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of every licensed credit institution in Montenegro — the master watchlist that CRPS/gazette monitoring must be keyed against. Licence grants/withdrawals are themselves organization-change events.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the register table monthly; diff entity list to detect entries/exits; seed CRPS lookups from it.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetch of http://www.pretraga.crps.me/ failed with an OpenSSL TLSV1_ALERT_INTERNAL_ERROR on the HTTPS upgrade.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not read the CRPS search form, so the exact search fields, whether officer names are shown without login, and whether any JSON endpoint exists remain unconfirmed. Hypothesis: live but TLS/bot-unfriendly to this fetcher, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: CRPS is the cell's keystone source; the collection pipeline design depends on whether officer data is exposed to unauthenticated queries and in what shape.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Serbian for a CRPS change bulletin / RSS / 'objave o promjenama' style feed equivalent to Croatia's or Serbia's registry announcement streams.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence found of a public chronological feed of CRPS registration changes; monitoring appears to require per-entity polling and diffing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Rules out an event-stream architecture; the collector must maintain a watchlist and snapshot-diff, which sets cost and latency expectations.

negative_findings.description: Probed for hypothesised Montenegrin company-data portals 'bizniscrnagora' and 'boniteti.me'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Neither returned evidence of existence for Montenegro; CompanyWall.me is the dominant local-language credit/company-data aggregator instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated source entry and concentrates aggregator effort on CompanyWall plus the English-language bulk vendors.

negative_findings.description: Montenegroberza / MNSE issuer-announcement section was not directly opened in this run; only the exchange's existence and two candidate domains (montenegroberza.com, mnse.me) were established from search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Exact announcements URL and whether an RSS/feed exists is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Exchange disclosure is likely the fastest legal signal of bank board changes; the pipeline needs the real endpoint before it can be scheduled.

negative_findings.description: Montenegro's Law on Credit Institutions moved banks to a two-tier system, replacing 'izvršni direktor' + 'odbor direktora' with 'uprava' + 'nadzorni odbor'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both vocabularies coexist across historical filings and current pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any keyword-based extraction over CRPS, the gazette or bank pages must match BOTH term sets or it will silently miss changes on one side of the transition.

coverage_gaps.description: Whether CRPS exposes officer/authorised-person data to unauthenticated search, and whether there is a machine-readable endpoint or bulk download, is unresolved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-based (real TLS/UA) session against pretraga.crps.me and crps.me/Portal/Start, capture network requests, and document field names and any JSON API; if closed, document the euprava.me formal-extract route as the fallback.

coverage_gaps.description: The lag between an actual board/representative change, its CRPS filing, its gazette publication (where applicable) and its appearance in OpenCorporates/CompanyWall is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pick 3-5 known 2025-2026 Montenegrin bank leadership changes and back-test the appearance date in each source to rank them by timeliness.

coverage_gaps.description: No source found in this cell covering court-register / insolvency and liquidation proceedings (stečaj, likvidacija) for financial entities, which are organization-change events adjacent to the register.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout Privredni sud Crne Gore and the gazette's stečaj notices in a follow-up cell.

coverage_gaps.description: GLEIF/LEI records and MONSTAT's statistical business register were hypothesised as complementary entity-identifier sources but not searched in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add targeted queries for GLEIF LEI issuance for Montenegrin banks and MONSTAT 'statistički poslovni registar' in the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Personal-data (GDPR-aligned Montenegrin Zakon o zaštiti podataka o ličnosti) constraints on systematically compiling named directors' histories were not assessed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Document a lawful-basis note limiting collection to role-holder names in their professional capacity, and check each aggregator's ToS before automated collection.

brief: Montenegro's leadership-change intelligence rests on one keystone — CRPS, the Central Register of Business Entities run by the Uprava prihoda i carina — where every change of an authorised representative or board member is a mandatory filing, complemented by the beneficial-ownership register inside the same eFirma system. The actor universe is cleanly enumerable from CBCG's registers of banks, payment institutions and e-money institutions plus the Capital Markets Commission's licensed-participant lists, and the fastest-moving disclosure surfaces are the Commission's Centralni registar propisanih informacija, Montenegroberza issuer notices, Službeni list Crne Gore for state-linked appointments, and each bank's own upravni/nadzorni odbor page. Because no public change-stream feed appears to exist, collection must be watchlist-driven snapshot-and-diff, with CompanyWall.me and OpenCorporates as more automatable secondary layers whose refresh latency still needs measuring. Two practical risks: the CRPS search endpoint rejected automated TLS handshakes in this run (unverified, likely live), and the two-tier governance reform means extraction must match both the old 'izvršni direktor / odbor direktora' and the new 'uprava / nadzorni odbor' vocabularies.
